```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(foundry)

# Read your unit's data and keep the columns you need
master <- datasets.read_table("ay27_1_master")
dat <- master |>
  filter(BrigadeName == "YOUR BRIGADE") |>
  select(response_var, explanatory_var)
mod <- lm(response_var ~ explanatory_var, data = dat)
```

## BLUF

One short paragraph: the question, the answer, and the recommendation.

## Background

Who the decision maker is, what construct you measured, and the proxy you used.

## Data

Where the data came from and how many soldiers are in it (`r nrow(dat)`).

## Analysis and Results

```{r}
ggplot(dat, aes(x = explanatory_var, y = response_var)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
```

State the hypotheses, the test statistic, the P-value, and the conclusion in context.

## Assumptions

```{r}
#| layout-ncol: 2
plot(mod, which = 1)
hist(mod$residuals, main = "Residuals")
```

## Limitations

What the data can't tell you.
